## To siftDown (arr: Seq of Int, start: Int, end: Int) -> Seq of Int:
    Let mutable result be arr.
    Let mutable root be start.
    While 2 * root + 1 is at most end:
        Let child be 2 * root + 1.
        Let mutable swapIdx be root.
        If item (swapIdx + 1) of result is less than item (child + 1) of result:
            Set swapIdx to child.
        If child + 1 is at most end:
            If item (swapIdx + 1) of result is less than item (child + 2) of result:
                Set swapIdx to child + 1.
        If swapIdx equals root:
            Return result.
        Let tmp be item (root + 1) of result.
        Set item (root + 1) of result to item (swapIdx + 1) of result.
        Set item (swapIdx + 1) of result to tmp.
        Set root to swapIdx.
    Return result.

## Main
Let arguments be args().
Let n be parseInt(item 2 of arguments).
Let mutable arr be a new Seq of Int.
Let mutable seed be 42.
Let mutable i be 0.
While i is less than n:
    Set seed to (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648.
    Push (seed / 65536) % 32768 to arr.
    Set i to i + 1.
Let mutable start be (n - 2) / 2.
While start is at least 0:
    Set arr to siftDown(arr, start, n - 1).
    Set start to start - 1.
Let mutable end be n - 1.
While end is greater than 0:
    Let tmp be item 1 of arr.
    Set item 1 of arr to item (end + 1) of arr.
    Set item (end + 1) of arr to tmp.
    Set end to end - 1.
    Set arr to siftDown(arr, 0, end).
Let mutable checksum be 0.
Set i to 1.
While i is at most n:
    Set checksum to (checksum * 31 + item i of arr) & 268435455.
    Set i to i + 1.

## To native args () -> Seq of Text
## To native parseInt (s: Text) -> Int

## A Tree is either:
    A Leaf.
    A Node with left Tree and right Tree.

## To bottomUpTree (depth: Int) -> Tree:
    If depth equals 0:
        Return a new Leaf.
    Return a new Node with left bottomUpTree(depth - 1) and right bottomUpTree(depth - 1).

## To check (tree: Tree) -> Int:
    Inspect tree:
        When Leaf: Return 1.
        When Node (left, right): Return 1 + check(left) + check(right).

## Main
Let arguments be args().
Let n be parseInt(item 2 of arguments).
Let minDepth be 4.
Let maxDepth be n.
If minDepth + 2 is greater than maxDepth:
    Set maxDepth to minDepth + 2.

Let stretchCheck be check(bottomUpTree(maxDepth + 1)).
Show "stretch tree of depth " + (maxDepth + 1) + "\t check: " + stretchCheck.

Let longLived be bottomUpTree(maxDepth).

Let depth be minDepth.
While depth is at most maxDepth:
    Let iterations be 1 shifted left by (maxDepth - depth + minDepth).
    Let totalCheck be 0.
    Let i be 0.
    While i is less than iterations:
        Set totalCheck to totalCheck + check(bottomUpTree(depth)).
        Set i to i + 1.
    Show "" + iterations + "\t trees of depth " + depth + "\t check: " + totalCheck.
    Set depth to depth + 2.
Show "long lived tree of depth " + maxDepth + "\t check: " + check(longLived).

## To ssig0 (x: Word32) -> Word32:
    Return rotr(x, 7) xor rotr(x, 18) xor word32Shr(x, 3).

## To ssig1 (x: Word32) -> Word32:
    Return rotr(x, 17) xor rotr(x, 19) xor word32Shr(x, 10).

## To bsig0 (x: Word32) -> Word32:
    Return rotr(x, 2) xor rotr(x, 13) xor rotr(x, 22).

## To bsig1 (x: Word32) -> Word32:
    Return rotr(x, 6) xor rotr(x, 11) xor rotr(x, 25).

## To ch (x: Word32) and (y: Word32) and (z: Word32) -> Word32:
    Return word_and(x, y) xor word_and(word_not(x), z).

## To maj (x: Word32) and (y: Word32) and (z: Word32) -> Word32:
    Return word_and(x, y) xor word_and(x, z) xor word_and(y, z).

## To sha256Compress (state: Seq of Word32) and (m: Seq of Word32) and (kk: Seq of Word32) -> Seq of Word32:
    Let mutable sched be a new Seq of Word32.
    Repeat for x in m:
        Push x to sched.
    Repeat for t from 16 to 63:
        Let s0 be ssig0(item (t - 14) of sched).
        Let s1 be ssig1(item (t - 1) of sched).
        Let nw be s1 + (item (t - 6) of sched) + s0 + (item (t - 15) of sched).
        Push nw to sched.
    Let mutable a be item 1 of state.
    Let mutable b be item 2 of state.
    Let mutable c be item 3 of state.
    Let mutable d be item 4 of state.
    Let mutable e be item 5 of state.
    Let mutable f be item 6 of state.
    Let mutable g be item 7 of state.
    Let mutable h be item 8 of state.
    Repeat for t from 0 to 63:
        Let t1 be h + bsig1(e) + ch(e, f, g) + (item (t + 1) of kk) + (item (t + 1) of sched).
        Let t2 be bsig0(a) + maj(a, b, c).
        Set h to g.
        Set g to f.
        Set f to e.
        Set e to d + t1.
        Set d to c.
        Set c to b.
        Set b to a.
        Set a to t1 + t2.
    Let mutable out be a new Seq of Word32.
    Push (item 1 of state) + a to out.
    Push (item 2 of state) + b to out.
    Push (item 3 of state) + c to out.
    Push (item 4 of state) + d to out.
    Push (item 5 of state) + e to out.
    Push (item 6 of state) + f to out.
    Push (item 7 of state) + g to out.
    Push (item 8 of state) + h to out.
    Return out.
